RENTAL AGREEMENT

THIS RENTAL AGREEMENT is made at Bengaluru on this 3rd day of January, 2026, between Meena Iyer (hereinafter the "Landlord") and Rahul Nair (hereinafter the "Tenant").

RENT

The Tenant shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. 22,000 on or before the 7th day of each month, by bank transfer to the Landlord's account.

SECURITY DEPOSIT

The Tenant has paid an interest-free security deposit of Rs. 1,32,000, refundable within 15 days of vacating, subject to deduction of unpaid dues and damage beyond normal wear and tear.

TERM OF TENANCY

The tenancy is for a period of 12 months commencing from 10th January 2026.

TERMINATION

Either party may terminate this agreement by giving three months' written notice. Early termination by the Tenant shall result in one month's rent being deducted from the security deposit.

MAINTENANCE

The Landlord shall carry out structural repairs. The Tenant shall maintain the premises in good condition and shall be liable for damages caused by negligence.

UTILITIES

Electricity, water, and internet charges shall be borne by the Tenant as per actual usage.

RENEWAL

The parties may renew this agreement on mutually agreed terms, with an increase in rent of up to five per cent per annum.

SUBLETTING

The Tenant shall not sublet or assign the premises without the Landlord's prior written consent.
